A crucial away victory for Lyon!
Lyon edged past Lille in a hard-fought 1-0 encounter in Ligue 1 2026/27. Mads Bidstrup found the back of the net in the 40th minute to give Lyon the lead, and the visitors held on to secure all three points at the Decathlon Arena – Stade Pierre-Mauroy.
